description: Implement responsive sidebar collapse behavior with smooth transitions. Desktop (lg+): sidebar transitions between 240px (expanded) and 60px (collapsed, icons only). Mobile (<lg): sidebar overlays content when expanded, hidden when collapsed. Main content area expands to use freed space. Smooth 300ms ease-in-out transitions on width changes. Max content width ~1600px for large screens.
steps: In dashboard-shell.tsx, update the sidebar <aside> element with conditional classes based on sidebarCollapsed state. Desktop expanded: 'w-60'. Desktop collapsed: 'w-15' (60px). Add transition class: 'transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out'

For mobile: Keep existing hidden lg:flex behavior but add overlay logic. When sidebar is expanded on mobile, add fixed positioning with z-index to overlay content. Add backdrop/overlay div that appears on mobile when sidebar is open

Update navigation link labels: wrap label text in a span with conditional classes to hide when collapsed on desktop. Icons should remain visible. Use opacity-0 and overflow-hidden for smooth text fade

Update the main content wrapper div (currently 'lg:pl-60') with conditional padding based on sidebarCollapsed: collapsed: 'lg:pl-15', expanded: 'lg:pl-60'. Add transition: 'transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out'
Update the workspace selector and logo area in sidebar to show only icon when collapsed on desktop
Update the Sign out button and other sidebar footer elements to show only icons when collapsed
Add max-w-7xl or max-w-[1600px] constraint to main content for large screens
Ensure all interactive elements maintain proper click targets even when collapsed
Test mobile overlay: clicking outside sidebar on mobile should close it. Add onClick handler to backdrop overlay
acceptance_criteria: On desktop, sidebar smoothly transitions between 240px and 60px width
On mobile, sidebar overlays content when open and hides when closed
Main content area adjusts padding to match sidebar width
All transitions are smooth with 300ms duration
Icons remain visible in collapsed state, text labels hide smoothly
Clicking backdrop on mobile closes the sidebar
Main content has maximum width constraint on very large screens
verification: Manual test desktop: toggle sidebar, verify smooth 300ms transition between 240px and 60px widths
Manual test desktop collapsed: verify icons visible, text hidden, navigation still works
Manual test mobile: verify sidebar overlays content, backdrop closes sidebar
Manual test large screen: verify main content has max-width constraint
Manual test: verify state persists across page navigations within dashboard
findings: Successfully implemented responsive sidebar collapse behavior with smooth transitions. Desktop: sidebar transitions between 240px (w-60) and 60px (w-15) with 300ms ease-in-out animation. Mobile: sidebar overlays content with semi-transparent backdrop when expanded, slides off-screen (-translate-x-full) when collapsed. Main content padding adjusts dynamically (lg:pl-60 to lg:pl-15). Navigation labels, workspace selector, and footer buttons hide smoothly with opacity transitions when collapsed, showing only icons centered. Added custom CSS classes w-15 and lg:pl-15 in globals.css for the 60px collapsed width. Mobile backdrop closes sidebar on click. Main content max-width set to 1600px for large screens. All interactive elements maintain proper click targets. TypeScript compilation and linting passed successfully.
